correctness.rationale: In an increasing-value chamber, b_i=2i-n-1 and d_k=u_{pi(k+1)}-u_{pi(k)} yield J=sum_k k(n-k)d_k. Differentiating the nonuniform-mass clique generator gives coefficients C_{pi,k}=sum_i c_i^(k) r_{pi(i)}. Rearrangement gives exact maximum M_k, hence D^+J<=mu J, all-time Gronwall and iff contraction for M_k<=0. Concentrating a positive gap while keeping others eps realizes the logarithmic norm mu; tied states follow by continuity. For n<=3 all maxima negative; for n=4 only endpoint sign condition is nontrivial and becomes sorted r4<=9r1+3r2+r3. Independently verified exact c lists, exhaustive small permutations and 33/100 strict derivative for r=(1,14,1,1), u=(0,1,1.01,1.02). Does not claim exact finite-time norm equals e^(mu t).
